title: Ares Star Fighter (Crusader Industries, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Ares Star Fighter is a single-seat heavy fighter from Crusader Industries in Star Citizen, built to attack big ships. The whole ship is built around one large gun in the nose. It uses the common controls without changes.

panels.name: Ares Star Fighter: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Ares Star Fighter's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Main gun (one size-7 gun)
controls.text: One very large gun in the nose: a fast-firing gatling gun on the Inferno version, a laser on the Ion version.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (20 missiles)
controls.text: The Ares carries 20 missiles. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.
